name: Discrete Diode — 68V — SOT
description: Discrete 68V surface-mount diode cluster featuring BZV49-C68 and BZV90-C68 in SOT-89-3 and SOT-223-3_TabPin2 footprints.
selection_hints: Choose BZV49-C68 when an SOT-89-3 footprint is needed.
Choose BZV90-C68 when an SOT-223-3_TabPin2 footprint is needed.
Use for 68V discrete diode designs requiring surface-mount SOT packages.
avoid_when: Do not use if through-hole mounting is required instead of SMD.
Avoid when package footprints other than SOT-89-3 or SOT-223-3_TabPin2 are required.
Avoid if voltage ratings other than 68V are specified.
